description:

sections.title: The Services
paragraphs:
4.1 What we provide. Coreone provides bookkeeping and financial management tools, including a double-entry ledger, chart of accounts, invoices, vendor bills, payment records, expenses with receipt OCR, bank statement import and review, journal entries, reports, an audit trail and team permissions.

4.2 No professional advice. Coreone is software. We are not your accountant, auditor, tax adviser or lawyer, and the Services do not give professional advice. Reports are built from the entries you and your team post. Please consult a qualified professional for accounting, tax and legal decisions.

4.3 Tax and e-invoicing. The Services help you capture tax identity and invoice information in a structure designed for Nigerian requirements. Capturing that information does not make an invoice compliant with NRS/Rev360 or any other law. You remain responsible for deciding and applying tax treatment, charging and accounting for VAT, filing returns and meeting any e-invoicing duties. Where we later offer integration with NRS/Rev360, availability may depend on NRS onboarding, API access and specifications, which can change.

4.4 No handling of money. Coreone is not a bank, payment service provider or escrow agent. We do not hold, receive or transfer your money. Recording a payment in Coreone does not move funds. The bank details you show on invoices are your responsibility.

4.5 Changes. We may improve, change, add or remove features. If we remove a material feature from a paid Plan, we will give reasonable notice.
4.6 Beta features. Features labelled beta or preview may change or stop, and are provided as they are.

5.2 Review before posting. OCR and statement parsing are automated and can be wrong. You must review extracted receipt data and imported transactions before posting them. We are not responsible for errors you approve.

5.3 Posted entries. Posted entries are locked. You correct them by reversal or adjustment, and the Services keep an audit trail of material changes.

5.4 Rights to data. You must have the right, and any consent or other lawful basis needed, to upload personal data about customers, vendors, staff and others, including bank statements.

5.5 Legal compliance. You are responsible for complying with the laws that apply to your business, including tax, accounting, data protection and anti-money-laundering laws. 

5.6Copies. Use the export features to keep your own copies of your records.
